name: tailscale
description: Tailscale connector: Tailscale 1.104.7 by digest, in userspace networking (no tun or capability). Forwards tailnet TCP 443 to the linked edge with PROXY v2, using the link's target. TS_TARGET ([NAME@]ADDRESS:PORT) overrides it; NAME overrides the service's tailnet name. TS_AUTHKEY and TS_TARGET are optional secrets (service_secret_set). May start with no key. State lives on its data volume, so it logs in once. No port of its own; reaches only linked services.
